zh: Dragon Claw 新增「我的历史对话」：直接问“我之前问过……”“上次那个结论是什么”，AI 会搜索并翻看你自己的历史对话（含你参与的共享对话）再回答；只能查本人的对话，频道群聊里不提供，内容中的密钥会自动隐藏。
en: Dragon Claw can now search your past chats: ask "what did I ask before about…" or "what was the conclusion last time" and the AI searches and reads your own earlier conversations (including shared ones you joined). Only your own chats are searchable, it is not offered in channel group chats, and secrets are hidden automatically.
